name: timos-claude-code-plugins
description: Custom Claude Code plugins for development workflows (generic + per-language + per-topic). See ARCHITECTURE.md for the plugin family conventions.

plugins.name: development-swift
plugins.description: Swift development plugin with code review, formatting/linting, and Swift-specific tooling.

plugins.name: development
plugins.description: General development plugin with agents and skills.

plugins.name: development-python
plugins.description: Python maintenance dispatcher — fixes ruff / semgrep / Code Scanning / SonarCloud findings autonomously via per-tool agents in parallel worktrees, auto-bumps deps (patch + minor + major) with test-based verification. Favors autonomy over speed: expect tens-of-thousands of tokens per run.

plugins.name: development-claude-plugin
plugins.description: Plugin family for projects that ARE Claude Code plugins. Ships a test harness (/development-claude-plugin:test) and a maintenance dispatcher that validates plugin conventions and composes alongside the language plugin. Validators: version sync, SKILL.md/agent frontmatter, orphaned skill/agent references, directory layout, and shell-script quality (shellcheck / zsh -n).
